method_selection.rationale: Scale-normalised intervals are preferred for count data; the absolute residual comparator is reported and its conditional coverage is worse at high-risk sites.

traffic_volume.reason: The current Chicago AADT dataset is a 2026 snapshot and the historical 2006 study is too old/sparse. Using either for 2017–2025 training would leak future exposure or misrepresent current exposure; no volume values were manufactured.

feature_ablation_v1_vs_v2.note: Same training rows and evaluation rows; V1 hyperparameters for the V1 feature set, V2 hyperparameters for the V2 feature set.

comparison.note: Retrospective diagnostic on the previously inspected 2025-09..2026-08 period.

validation.selection_rule: deviance improvement >= 1% and MAE regression <= 2% on pre-test folds
